source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: A meta-analysis of more than 1,800 MPNST patients from 48 studies over five decades found increased mortality for NF1 patients with MPNST compared with sporadic MPNST, although outcomes have improved in the past decade.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 16 Kolberg 2013 PMID 23161774. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Meta-analysis; the guideline reports it as differing from the Finnish registry data. Graded 3 because only the secondary summary was read; Rey may upgrade toward 4.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 16
